evidence.name: Screen field: Style the paywall subtitle
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the paywall subtitle" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the paywall subtitle
sections.description: Styles the subtitle line: font, size, weight, color, alignment, and the spacing around it. Keep it smaller and lighter than the headline so the main benefit stays dominant. Leave the theme defaults unless the subtitle is hard to read against your background.
